title: Theo and the Oath
author: Felix Thackeray
blurb: Ada Okonkwo, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
